:::{#def-pairwise-disjoint}
#### Pairwise disjoint sets (disjoint, mutually disjoint)

Finitely or countably many sets $A_1, A_2, \ldots$
are **pairwise disjoint**
[@wikipedia_disjoint_sets]
(also called **disjoint** or **mutually disjoint**)
when no two of them share an element:

$$A_i \cap A_j = \emptyset \quad \text{for all } i \neq j$$

:::
